_comment: Attribution obligations the NuGet restore graph cannot express. Each entry is appended verbatim by Scripts/Generate-ThirdPartyNotices.ps1.

licenseOverrides.reason: Nuspec declares its licence only via the deprecated <licenseUrl> element (https://bitmiracle.github.io/libtiff.net/help/articles/license.html), not a machine-readable <license type="expression"|"file">, so the generator cannot resolve an SPDX id automatically. Verified BSD-3-Clause from the project's own license page, 2026-09-14.

supplements.title: .NET 10 runtime and base class libraries
supplements.note: Embedded into the application by self-contained single-file publishing. They are part of the shipped artifact but never appear as package entries in the restore graph. The notice files shipped inside the runtime packs themselves are reproduced in section 3.

supplements.title: FFmpeg
supplements.note: DiffusionNexus does not bundle FFmpeg. When no ffmpeg/ffprobe pair is found on the machine, the application downloads official builds at runtime and runs them as a separate process. Those binaries are covered by their own licence (LGPL-2.1-or-later, or GPL for some builds), which travels with them.
